title: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.13020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. translated_title: 轨迹感知策略优化：弥合长程大语言模型强化学习中的状态分布差距
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的主流范式。然而，长程自回归 rollout 引入了一个根本性限制：局部策略失配会在轨迹中不断累积，演变为严重的状态分布偏移。现有的 LLM 强化学习方法（如 GRPO 和 GSPO）在 token 或序列层面控制策略失配，但忽略了这种由轨迹引起的偏移，导致随着长度的增长出现训练不稳定乃至最终的训练崩溃。为了弥合状态分布差距，我们提出了轨迹感知策略优化（TAPO），这是一个有原则性的框架，从离策略策略梯度中理论推导出状态分布修正项，并将其纳入强化学习目标之中。TAPO 还进一步采用几何均值估计器来降低方差，并结合长度感知的动态裁剪机制，防止更新在整条轨迹上过度偏离。大量实验表……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出轨迹感知策略优化（TAPO），通过将理论推导的状态分布修正项融入强化学习目标，并配合几何均值方差缩减与长度感知动态裁剪，弥合长程 LLM 强化学习中的状态分布偏移，解决训练不稳定与崩溃问题。
en_tdlr: TAPO closes the state distribution gap in long-horizon LLM RL by theoretically deriving a state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient, combined with a geometric-mean variance reduction estimator and length-aware dynamic clipping to prevent training collapse.
